page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8ae.64xlarge is a high-capacity bare-metal server belonging to the ECS Bare Metal family. The server provides dedicated execution capabilities powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz. With 256 dedicated vCPUs, the configuration is designed to deliver sustained parallel compute capabilities without hypervisor contention.

System memory totals 1536.0 GB, which yields an allocation ratio of 6.0 GB of RAM per core. High-throughput network connectivity is supported with a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring persistent workloads to attach external cloud storage volumes. Furthermore, the configuration provisions no discrete GPU hardware accelerators and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By aggregating 256 dedicated cores and 1.5 TB of memory within a single bare-metal chassis, the host provides efficient physical resource consolidation for enterprise environments. The hardware footprint is matched to high-volume multi-threaded tasks, enterprise databases, in-memory caching platforms, large-scale ETL pipelines, and high-density container orchestration clusters.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8ae.64xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal server architected for enterprise-scale computational and memory demands. The instance is powered by dedicated x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processors operating at 3.4 GHz, supplying a total of 256 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1536.0 GB of system memory, translating to 6.0 GB of RAM per core. Networking capabilities feature a 100 Gbps baseline bandwidth to support high-throughput data exchanges. The server includes no onboard local storage, meaning disk operations rely entirely on external block storage volumes, and it includes no hardware accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The high CPU core density paired with balanced, substantial memory capacity delivers efficient resource aggregation for large-scale enterprise deployments without hypervisor virtualization overhead. The ecs.ebmg8ae.64xlarge is well positioned for large in-memory databases, massive multi-threaded batch processing, high-density container orchestration, enterprise resource planning suites, and distributed ETL pipelines requiring substantial dedicated compute threads.
